description.en: Copies the position and look-at point of the map's start camera (the camera the map begins with) into two arrays. Without that camera, pos is [0, 100, 100] and ref is [0, 0, 0].
Receives [x, y, z] of the position.
Receives [x, y, z] of the look-at point.
Always null; the results are in the arrays.
